| Platform | Type | Public API | Endpoint | URL patterns | robots.txt | Generic | Verified | Notes |

| BrassRing | ATS | partial | `GET {host}/TGnewUI/Search/Home/HomeWithPreLoad?partnerid={p}&siteid={s}&PageType=searchResults (preloadJSON: first 50 jobs + JobsCount) + PageType=JobDetails&jobid={reqid} (full posting); more than 50 only via POST /TgNewUI/Search/Ajax/ProcessSortAndShowMoreJobs` | `{sjobs\|krb-sjobs\|xjobs}.brassring.com/TGnewUI/Search/Home/Home?partnerid={p}&siteid={s}`<br>`…/HomeWithPreLoad?partnerid={p}&siteid={s}&PageType=JobDetails&jobid={reqid}` | allowed | untested | no | Not built (2026-11-08): no allowed route lists more than 50 jobs. robots.txt is 404 on sjobs/krb-sjobs/xjobs.brassring.com. The server-rendered HomeWithPreLoad?PageType=searchResults page embeds the first 50 jobs and the true JobsCount, and ignores every paging/keyword/sort parameter (PageNumber, page, pageno, keyword, SortType tried). Job details are complete over GET (PageType=JobDetails). Further pages exist only as POST /TgNewUI/Search/Ajax/ProcessSortAndShowMoreJobs carrying encryptedSessionValue (#CookieValue) and the RFT/__RequestVerificationToken issued by the page: page-issued tokens are not used. Sites checked: 9 live sites have 155-24,005 jobs (FCPS 25103/5042: 56; Home Depot 25526/5032: 24,005; 26235/5374: 681; 25771/5403: 2,164; 25879/5295: 949; 25633/5439: 1,350; 25307/5238: 319; xjobs 25348/5039: 155), 3 have 0 (Lockheed Martin migrated). A connector limited to boards of 50 jobs or fewer would work but no such live board was found. |

The career site (/ux/ats/careersite/{n}/home?c={corp}) and requisition pages are 5 KB JS shells; jobs come only from POST /services/x/career-site/v1/search with the bearer token in csod.context.token (401 without it on americares and ymca, 2026-11-08). No sitemap (/sitemap.xml 404, careersite sitemap redirects to login), legacy JobDetails.aspx/search.aspx redirect to the shell. |
| JobBoardFire | Job board | unknown | `{board}.jobboardfire.com (HTML)` | `{board}.jobboardfire.com`<br>`{board}.jobboardfire.com/c/{company-slug}`<br>`custom domains` | allowed | untested | no | productmarketing.jobboardfire.com returned HTTP 403 to our User-Agent (2026-11-07): bot protection. |
| talentReef | ATS | partial | `apply.jobappnetwork.com/clients/{clientId} (React SPA, 751-byte shell); data from POST prod-kong.internal.talentreef.com/apply/proxy-es/search-en-us/posting/_search (Elasticsearch query, filter clientId.raw)` | `apply.jobappnetwork.com/clients/{clientId}`<br>`apply.jobappnetwork.com/clients/{clientId}/posting/{jobId}[/{locale}]`<br>`apply.jobappnetwork.com/{templateURL}` | allowed | untested | no | Not built: waiting for an owner decision (2026-11-08). Career pages are a JS shell; the production app bundle sends its job search, without any token, to an Elasticsearch proxy at prod-kong.internal.talentreef.com/apply/proxy-es/{search-en-us\|search-fr-ca\|search-es-us}/posting/_search (robots.txt 404). One GET ?size=1 returned 200 with full postings (title, HTML description, address, brand, clientId/clientName, contractType, internalOrExternal; 190,608 hits in the index). The host is named internal and takes arbitrary Elasticsearch queries, so further use was stopped pending approval. The public site filters by clientId.raw (+ brand.raw, location.id) and, for external candidates, internalOrExternal = externalOnly. |

## Research gaps

22 todo platforms have fewer than 2 verified example boards: Artha, BrassRing, CSOD, CareerPlug, CareerSiteCloud, Dayforce, Dover, FirstStage, Freshteam, JOIN.com, JobBoardFire, JobKit, Nodex, Paycom, Paycor, Talenetic, UltiPro, eJobBoard, ejobsitesoftware.com, jobBoardHQ, jobboardsoftware.com, talentReef.

"Verified" means the endpoint and examples answered a live request on that date; "no" means the entry comes from documentation or prior knowledge and must be re-checked before implementation. "Generic" = whether the generic sitemap/RSS + schema.org JobPosting approach worked on the evaluated boards (`scripts/evaluate_generic.py`).
